attacks.name: Feline Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Hex|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

attacks.name: Sorry, No Autographs
steps: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 3 of itself.
|!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Ambush Predator
superPowers.body: Throw this character |!movement_medium|. It does not suffer |!damage| when colliding with another character or terrain feature. If this character began the Throw overlapping a terrain feature with a |!size| larger than itself, ends the Throw no longer overlapping it, and collides with a character, that character suffers 4 collision |!damage| instead of 3. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Mess With the Cat and You Get the Claws
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if the attacker is within |!range| 3, this character may use this superpower. Roll 4 dice. The attacker suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!wild| in the result.

superPowers.name: Empathetic Aura
superPowers.body: Other allied characters within |!range| 2 may reroll 1 die in their defense rolls.

superPowers.name: On the Prowl
superPowers.body: While this character is within |!range| 1 of a terrain feature of |!size| 2 or more, this character gains the |*Stealth| |!innate| superpower.

superPowers.name: Superior Agility
superPowers.body: Enemy characters cannot reroll or modify attack dice when targeting this character with attacks.
